steps.selector: [data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major']

steps.label: UAT-4.3: every row leads with the fixed details chip (glyph when not in set)
stash the reggae row's height + lead width (the no-reflow reference)
steps.js: (function(){var row=document.querySelector('[data-npkey="reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major"]');if(!row)return false;var l=row.querySelector('.li-lead');window.__rowRef={h:row.getBoundingClientRect().height,lw:l.getBoundingClientRect().width};return true;})()

steps.selector: [data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major'] .li-body

steps.label: UAT-4.2: a BODY tap on a playable row PLAYS it (mini bar, correct embed) - no details detour
UAT-4.1: the bar POPS while live - npLive set, accent outline applied, equalizer visible and animating
steps.js: (function(){var p=document.querySelector('.bt-player');if(!p.classList.contains('npLive'))return false;var bar=p.querySelector('.bt-st-head');var eq=p.querySelector('.bt-st-bareq');if(!bar||!eq||eq.offsetParent===null)return false;var i=eq.querySelector('i');var cs=getComputedStyle(i);var barCs=getComputedStyle(bar);var ink=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent-ink').trim();return cs.animationName==='liEq'&&cs.animationPlayState==='running'&&barCs.borderColor!=='';})()

steps.label: UAT-4.4/v5: the long title LOOP-marquees left-only (second copy present, negative travel, linear + infinite - never a shuttle)
steps.js: (function(){var t=document.querySelector('.bt-st-t');if(!t)return false;var tx=t.querySelector('.bt-st-tx');if(!tx)return false;var mq=t.classList.contains('mq');if(!mq)return false;var clone=tx.querySelector('.bt-st-tx2');if(!clone)return false;var v=parseInt(t.style.getPropertyValue('--mq'),10);if(!(v<0))return false;var cs=getComputedStyle(tx);return cs.animationIterationCount==='infinite'&&cs.animationTimingFunction==='linear';})()

steps.label: UAT-4.5: pause freezes the bar equalizer (npPaused strips the animation, bars hold still) - same grammar as the row's isPaused

steps.selector: [data-npkey='reggae backing track in a major|petti music studios|A|major'] .li-lead

steps.label: UAT-4.3b: the lead chip on the PLAYING row opens details by EXPANDING the same Studio (iframe untouched - audio never restarts)
UAT-4.3c: joining the set puts the # INSIDE the lead chip - same chip width, same row height (no reflow)
steps.js: (function(){var row=null,rows=document.querySelectorAll('#songsList .listItem');for(var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){if(/Mellow Reggae Jam/.test(rows[i].textContent)){row=rows[i];break;}}if(!row)return false;var n=row.querySelector('.li-lead .li-num');if(!n||!n.textContent.trim())return false;var ref=window.__rowRef;var l=row.querySelector('.li-lead');return Math.abs(l.getBoundingClientRect().width-ref.lw)<=2;})()
